reviews.text:
I usually go to petsmart with my fav groomer to cut my dog hair, but since this place is close by, I gave it a shot. Turned out they cut my dog hair terribly and charged $110 for this ugly haircut. They just too lazy to cut her and decided to shave it all off, why would I spend $110 to shave my dog hair?
Please trust the bad reviews, I regret that did not trusted them!!!
Always do a great job and very responsive
Great

Edit: I wanted to see the best in premier since I’ve been taking my dog for so long, but I can’t in good conscience recommend them anymore! There’s once again been a change in their groomers, with zero communication to customers. This is maybe the 4th-5th time this has happened in the last year. At some point, you have to look at the common denominator, and ownership seems to be unable to retain their (good) employees. Sad to say it, but will not be returning and I do not recommend it to any new customers. Grooming is part of a dog’s health care (at least for poodles) and it’s essential to have continuity and reliability—and at the very least communication in the absence of these.

I’ve been taking my standard poodle to premier pet services for almost two years now! He’s had three groomers: Bella, Cleu, and currently Sekou. They’ve all been great for different reasons! Sekou does the best top-knots I’ve ever seen, highly recommend him (photos from his latest groom)! The business is currently going through some changes that they’re navigating, and I think some recent reviews have been harsh as a result. Don’t take these to heart, it’s a good business that takes great care of our pups, and I will continue to trust them with my boy!
Easy scheduling, helpful staff and expert service! Thanks again!
Great grooming!  Nice people, fair prices.  Sekour did lovely job on Ohana!

Honestly up until recently this shop has been running just fine. Last few instances coming here haven’t been great and today was the final straw. Had my 10:30am appointment canceled, 45 mins beforehand, then rescheduled to 8am the next day, showed up, nobody there, texted the owner and she said she’d be there by 8:25, apologizing for being late… I waited outside until 8:45, and left. They knew I had travel plans and hence why it was already annoying they cancelled 45 mins before an appointment that’s been scheduled for weeks. Now this? Yeah I’d be cautious here working with this company.
Love it there! They are so kind and so good with my dog Boots. They did they cut exactly how we like it!
Great experience, kind, professional and very caring towards my dog, great experience!

I love this place! I’ve brought my cat here for baths about three times, and he always comes back smelling great with soft, clean fur. The staff is polite, and the entire process, from scheduling the appointment to pickup, is smooth and hassle-free.
PLACE IS HORRIFIC MY DOG IS ALL MESSED UP AND UNEVEN PLACE STUNK AND MY PUPPY WAS THERE FOR 6PLUS HOURS JUST TO BE MESSED UP

Worst service ever! I went online to book an appointment, and after answering every possible question about the Dog, vet, dates, addresses, vaccination, we are things I’ve never heard about, it took me 20 minutes then I had to sign several release forms then I finally got to the end where they asked me for a credit card and I got an error message saying that their stripe account is not active. What a waste of time! 😡
Remi was in need of a spring cut! Will definitely come back
Love this place, they always do a great job with my dog!

The best groomer for Samoyeds by far! Our large hospital veterinarian practice started a grooming service. They told us that our Samoyeds had such tangled hair underneath that he would require at least a $2,000 anesthesia to then shave his coach because it was so tangled. Thankfully, we found Premier where the owner Kelly explained that crisscrossed weblike undercoat is the “primitive coat” which is what provides the Samoyed breed with superior insulation. Of that would have been shaven as or veterinary hospital groomer and a veterinarian had insisted, it would have ruined our Samoyed’s coat! Kelly even called over to that veterinary hospital practice and offered to educate them for free to spare any other Samoyed that large veterinary practice’s misguided and ruinous treatment to so outlandishly “groom” a Samoyed. Kelly and Premier are the very best!

Chicken Parmigiana (Kenny) has been coming here for going on two years. The first year, we had a regular groomer who consistently gave a great cut and was so good with our dog. She was always pleasant and communicative.
Since then, Kenny has had a different groomer every time. It’s never a good feeling leaving your dog with someone you aren’t familiar without, especially without any notice. I really value a consistent groomer so I can trust the service and care of my dog. Unfortunately because of this, she’s had inconsistent hair cuts, this last one seeming like barely anything was taken off. She’ll need to be groomed again in 3 weeks. I literally took her home and trimmed the areas that were too long.
There was another time an area was shaved too close to the skin on her face and she was nicked. And I understand this happens sometimes, but to not be told, especially when blood was drawn, is careless. I’m surprised I came back after that.
The long and short of it is, it’s hard to support a place and trust in the care of my dog when it can no longer retain staff. The only cash payment is annoying too.
They are well organized, very sweet with the dogs, and always do a great job with our cavapoo.

We called to book an appointment on Sunday for our dog Hudson and they were completely booked.

Anaya was nice enough to call us after they had a cancelation and got us in for a full bathing and grooming.

They were prompt, reasonably priced and they did a great job! It was our first time using them and we already plan to go back! Great local business!
The groomer at Premier Pet is awesome! She does a great job with our Australian Labradoodle. I am always very happy with how he looks.
i've been a customer at premier per services for 3-4 years and i've never been disappointed with services the owner and staff have gone above and beyond with their services
Professional service! Was able to fit me in on busy Saturday. Thank you guys! ❤️
My dogs came here before and they did a great job on both
My dog Jiggy loves premier pet services! We used to take him to other groomers and he would always be sad on pickup but he's always happy when we pick him up here!
Premier pets is absolutely the best! My dog can’t wait to go!!!!!  The groomers are kind, patient and do a great job!
Very professional and thorough, and very kind to my nervous dog
Nino loves his fresh cut and he feels great. He loves his spa day!!
They are wonderful groomers and take great care with your pets.  I won't go anywhere else.

My dog actually enjoys coming here. That is a representation of how kind and caring the groomers are and patient. It took us a while to find a groomer and we have loved every service over the past 2 years.

I have a 10 lb dog, who acts like a 150 lb Rotti. I don't know how they do it, but they do. My Bella is a Havachu mix & is terrified of the bath & the sound of clippers. Some how they're able to groom Bella without any problems. They're kind & gentle with the experience of "how to handle" her! Bella looks absolutely adorable when we leave there. Great prices for what they have to do.
Our dog is VERY reactive and the employees here do so well with him! Great, in fact! Thanks to Kelley and her crew!
This is a fake account and there’s no record of a “Sanaa Kane” ever being services at Premier Pets.
They were so quick and did such a great job. Our cat looks good, smells good, and they were so nice.i will keep taking my cat to this place. They are great!

Wanted to get my maltipoo pup groomed before the holiday. My regular groomer was booked, so I was open to trying this place. Since they are more expensive ($95 base) I had high expectations, only for my puppy’s cut to be jagged and not what I asked for. Cleuciane mentioned he moved a lot which is what puppies do. This was not his first groom and we’ve been able to get great cuts from my regular groomer, which implies this was a skill issue. They also only take cash which is inconvenient. Very disappointed.
The services were outstanding.  They asked about any specific needs as well as the overall health of my dog.

This place was wonderful the first time I came with my parent’s aging chocolate lab. Bella cut her nails quickly and calmly, and showed so much care in making her feel safe and comfortable.

This review is late in coming, but I booked another appointment a few months ago with Bella to get our puppy’s nails trimmed but when we got there, Bella wasn’t there and another woman took the dog with no explanation and wasn’t able to answer my questions due to a language barrier. That would have been fine, but she honestly didn’t seem at all interested in how uncomfortable my dog was and wasn’t able to even complete the nail trim. My puppy won’t let me near his nails now, and I can’t find Bella on the scheduler anymore, which is a shame because she was awesome.

I've been going to Premier for about a year now. Wonderful service,  great cuts and that take care of my dogs.  Since I have one that has spinal problems I am very concerned about how she is held or maneuvered and the girls at Premier take great care of my baby. I highly recommend them

I WOULD GIVE A NEGATIVE SCORE IF I COULD! DID NOT LISTEN TO ANYTHING.
I’m heartbroken after bringing my long-haired cat here. I showed clear photos and explained I only wanted her coat lightly trimmed to clean up sparse hairs, not shaved. My cat was not matted (I brush her regularly), and I wanted a proper sanitary clean, but even that was done uneven - the back area was left untrimmed while the ventral front was cut too short.

The groomer, who didn’t speak much English, used clippers with a “long guard,” ran it down my cat’s back, and said it would only take a little off. It looked fine at first, I still showed her pics of what I didn’t t want to clarify in case it would look like that and she assured me it won’t. But when I picked her up, her beautiful coat was unevenly shaved, her tail looked rough and matted, she didn’t smell good and was shedding was too much. They just dried her and handed her to me unbrushed.

There was absolutely no reason for such a drastic cut, and my clear instructions were ignored. Please be cautious bringing your pets here, especially long-haired cats.
This place is great! They do weekends and my pup is always happy after.  Would recommend
Thank you so much for taking care of Kendra. I love her new look!!
I’m a big fan of Premier and recommend them frequently to other dog owners. They do a great job with our big, hairy dog.  Very kind groomers. And I appreciate the emphasis on health and safety.

Very nice people. They really care. This was my long haird cats first grooming and he was NOT happy. The groomer worked so well with him and talked with me after about how he did and what she learned about him, and how to make his next experience even better. He came home smelling and looking wonderful!
Love it here !
My doggo was treated so well. He has so much anxiety around nail trimming  and the owner Made Lazlo feel at home.
So caring and great with pets!
Wonderful business and great with pups!
Kelley has a heart of gold & you can tell she loves all of her furry clients!
Thank you, Sara! We’re glad you’re happy with our prices and service.
Great service
Incredibly caring kind humans who are true professionals!
Bella makes my dogs experience pleasant

I don't think you'll ever find a company or business owner who cares more for their clients (furry and human) as well as their staff than this one does. I personally know Kelley has put in her blood, sweat, and tears to build her business from the ground up, and it shines through daily. She’s dedicated to her clients and her community, and I’d recommend Premier Pet Services to anyone in the area!

The owners are some of the kindest people I know. They truly care about the animals they groom and treat every pet with compassion and respect. This business reflects their values, and I’d trust them with any animal in my life.

Hi Jay,
We have no record of you as a client, and since you're based in CT and we're located in PA, this review seems misplaced. As a small business, reviews like this directly impact our hardworking staff who rely on this work to support themselves. If this was posted in error, we ask that you please remove it.
Friendly groomers, and they do a wonderful job with my doodle! We are return customers
Our dog has been going to premier pets for 5yrs and we won’t use anyone else. They do a great job.
Amazing service! My Pomeranian looks great
Amazing service! My Pomeranian was treated like royalty and the groomer fixed what another groomer messed up with my last visit to a different place! I would highly recommend
Bella was amazing and so patient with my anxious pup! Cooper was so happy, cute and clean!
Both my pups, including an anxious and reactive one, had awesome experiences here!

We were thrilled with the care our two senior pups enjoyed at Premier Pet Services! Thanks for being willing and able to meet the needs of our senior girls. Your care and professionalism are appreciated!
Cleaned up and took care of my kitty in a pinch! Couldn’t recommend them more.

The girls do such a great job with my Shih Tzu! He always looks so great. Other groomers cut him so short he looks like a rat. Lol. Premier Pets Services is a 30-minute drive from my house but it’s worth it. My new rescue puppy has her first appointment ever today and she also looks and smells amazing. Great place! Easy parking. Fast service. Cash only which sucks, but oh well.
We've been taking our nervous dog to get her nails trimmed by Bella for a while now and I love how calm it always is in the shop. It makes the process quick and easy.

My fur baby always leave smelling and looking amazing! Always prompt and rebooking appointments are always a breeze to keep me on schedule. Only negative is I wish they accepted cards, I rarely have cash on me.

Our boy Frankie is an anxious but friendly boy, Protective of his dads.  The team at premier was very patient in getting him used to a new grooming salon in a new state, since we just moved.  (Only his second grooming place since we adopted him 3 years ago). They made sure he was comfortable and less stressed.  Bonus points that Mari texted me pictures of sample dog face cuts to align with what we wanted!  I highly recommend the team at Premier!
I thank you for grooming my pretty baby knowing that she had to look good for her kittens. I love this company. They was friendly and Chloe is happy

Kelly’s love, affection and vast knowledge of what constitutes a lllò a isqq

Truly cannot ever give sufficient effusive praise for this beloved enterprise and its staff.

Premier Pet Services is great - they’re incredibly easy to book with, AFFORDABLE!! (this is huge), and they do a fantastic job and are so sweet. I’ve brought Wilson in a few times now and Bella does a great job with his cut. Can’t recommend this place enough!
Our pups always get the best care + service!

My golden retriever Molly is a very scared dog with noises and scissors and they managed to make her super cute. I am grateful to them for managing to leave her the way I like it. I recommend it 100,000 times.

Premier Pet Services was hands down the best groomers I have encountered. Extensively trained staff that truly loves what they do, and it shows. Great customer service, pricing and most of all their love of animals.

Could not recommend Premier Pet Services enough! We have a large, anxious dog and they were so accommodating with him. Their staff is so sweet, spent time in the beginning to walk through a plan and pricing, and kept us updated on timing for the appointment. Our dog got a fantastic bath and cut/de-shed, as well as nail trip and ear cleaning (which he won't even let us do!) We will be repeat customers for sure!
The owner Kelly and all of her staff go above and beyond. We’ve been a customer for over 2 years. Highly recommend for your pup!

Cleu always does a really good job with my little Havachon. Making appointments is easy, either text or call- they always pick up. Prices reasonable. I switched from another grooming service and I’m glad I did!

Bella did a fabulous job on my dear Choco , a small mix of ,well not really sure,  but best gromer I've met.
I would recommend her anytime!
They were so patient with our 9 month old puppy who is scared of baths and strangers. She looked so cute and clean!

An absolutely amazing experience! My roommate has a black lab/hound mix and I brought him in for a wash and deshedding. He is a very anxious dog, but my groomer Bella was very understanding and worked with him to make sure he felt comfortable during his visit! Her services were beyond expectations! Will be back again, but with my own cat :)
